## Mozi on love

Mozi (c. 470–c. 391 BCE) approaches love within Mohism. Jian ai (impartial concern) extends care beyond one’s own kin to all, measured by benefit to the world. Heaven (Tian) desires righteousness and watches conduct—an early form of divine command cum consequentialist ethic. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets love most directly—useful for searches such as “mozi quotes on love.”
